description: Find a building in Bavaria by its address, for the Dachcheck (roof check). Returns up to 5 matches with a house id. If several match, ask the person which one before planning.

address.description: Street, house number and town (or postcode) in Bavaria, e.g. "Forststraße 10, Neuried".

name: find_house
title: Find a house (Dachcheck)
